papers.title: Credible AUctions via MPC Gadgets: Bounding Information Leakage Under Abort
papers.titleZh: 通过MPC小工具实现可信拍卖：限制中止时的信息泄露
papers.abstract: The design of credible auctions---mechanisms where a revenue-maximizing auctioneer has no incentive to deviate from the protocol---faces a fundamental cryptographic barrier when the auctioneer controls shill bidders. While a natural approach is to use Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to remove the trusted auctioneer, the impossibility of fair coin flipping of Cleve (1986) implies that monolithic MPC protocols grant the auctioneer a "free option": they can learn the auction's outcome and unilaterally abort if the revenue is unsatisfactory. Cryptographic commitments with ex-ante penalties mitigate this abort asymmetry, but no finite penalty suffices for heavy-tailed distributions. We circumvent this barrier by introducing the MPC Decomposition Principle. Rather than encrypting the entire mechanism, we use MPC strictly as an information-restriction tool. We isolate the winner determination problem into a minimal MPC gadget that computes and reveals the winner's identity but no payment information. This qualitative restriction mathematically bounds the information leaked upon an abort. By combining this gadget with sequential revelation and finite economic penalties, we design the Sequential Revelation Auction (SRA). We prove that bounding the information leakage strictly bounds the value of the free option, showing that a penalty of $k \geq \sum_{i=1}^n Rev(F_i)$ is sufficient for credibility, and tight: for equal-revenue distributions, every smaller penalty admits a profitable deviation. Using constant-round MPC, the SRA resolves an open question of Akbarpour and Li (2020) and Ferreira and Weinberg (2020) by providing a constant-round, incentive-compatible, revenue-optimal credible auction for all product distributions with vanishing revenue tails

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统可信拍卖面临一个根本难题：当拍卖方控制虚假竞拍者时，可通过观察结果后主动中止协议来获取不公平优势。这种‘免费选择权’使得标准加密方案失效，尤其在估值分布尾部较重的情况下，任何固定罚金都无法遏制恶意行为。本文旨在解决如何在不依赖完全信任的前提下，设计出既可信又收益最优的拍卖机制。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个单物品拍卖场景，包含真实竞拍人和由拍卖方控制的虚假竞拍人。各方提交经密码学承诺的报价，并通过具备可识别中止的安全多方计算（MPC）执行赢家判定。关键设定是拍卖方可在获知临时结果后选择中止，此时需付出罚金。机制的目标是在满足真实性、安全性和可信性的前提下最大化期望收益。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了顺序揭示拍卖（SRA）协议，首次实现了对所有具消失收益尾部的产品分布而言，常数轮次、激励相容且收益最优的可信拍卖。核心结果表明，只要罚金不低于两倍最大垄断收益（K≥2REV(F)），即可消除中止带来的套利空间，且该界限紧致，在等收益分布下无法进一步降低。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者引入MPC分解原则，仅将赢家身份作为最小功能放入MPC中计算，支付则通过后续顺序揭示确定。关键技术是信息泄露引理，量化了中止所暴露的信息价值上限。结合阈值策略归约与虚拟剩余分析，证明了罚金足以抵消任何偏离带来的额外收益，从而确保可信性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于依赖强密码学假设（如iO或MK-FHE）实现常数轮MPC，当前实际效率较低；同时假设独立私有价值与静态对手。尽管如此，其分解思想为可信机制设计提供了新范式，特别适合关注信息结构与激励交互的研究者深入阅读机制构造与证明技巧。

papers.title: Learning the Cost of Reliable Inference
papers.abstract: Benchmarking and routing platforms increasingly act as intermediaries connecting large language model providers with end-users. However, providers on these platforms typically use a fixed price per token, preventing users from achieving the most competitive price for their tasks. % workloads. In this work, we design a procurement platform where token prices for each task are driven by provider competition, enabling users to secure competitive pricing for guaranteed quality levels. To this end, the platform sequentially routes queries via a reverse second-price auction that incentivizes model providers to truthfully bid their best estimate of the average cost to serve a user's query. As it routes queries, the platform learns the quality offered by each provider and progressively routes queries to the most cost-competitive provider among those meeting a desired quality threshold. To validate our design, we conduct experiments with multiple LLMs from the \texttt{Llama} and \texttt{Qwen} families on popular mathematical reasoning and question-answering benchmarks. The results show that the pricing margin of the most cost-competitive provider on our platform varies significantly---from $10\%$ to $71\%$---depending on the task and quality threshold. This suggests a substantial inefficiency in the current fixed-price market, and it demonstrates that our platform may enable users to capture maximum savings whenever competitive market conditions permit.

papers.title: Pacing Equilibria in Abstract Mechanisms
papers.abstract: Digital platforms increasingly rely on automated budget-management systems to regulate participation across allocation opportunities. A common tool is multiplicative pacing, which scales buyers' bids so that campaign-level budgets are spent gradually. Although pacing is operationally simple, its aggregate behavior depends on the underlying mechanism. In first-price single-item auction markets, pacing enjoys strong structural and computational properties that often fail in second-price auctions. It is unclear whether these properties extend to richer platform mechanisms. We develop a unified theory of pacing equilibria across a hierarchy of mechanisms. We first show that, even in first-price position auctions, the market-equilibrium interpretation of the single-item benchmark can fail. We then identify bid-maximizing pay-your-bid mechanisms as a broad class in which pacing equilibria exist, are unique, and admit an Eisenberg-Gale-type convex-program characterization. This implies efficient computation, Pareto-efficiency, and liquid-welfare guarantees, enabling pacing integration into large-scale optimization-based allocation routines. Finally, for abstract mechanisms satisfying a payment monotonicity condition, we prove equilibrium existence by smoothing discontinuities. With additional conditions and appropriate tie-breaking, we obtain uniqueness, revenue maximality among budget-feasible pacing vectors, and shill-proof implementability, and provide convergent budget-adjustment dynamics for approximate equilibria. Overall, many favorable properties of first-price pacing extend beyond single-item auctions under appropriate mechanism-level conditions.

papers.title: The Power of Recruiting the Smaller Side: Two Additional Traders Suffice in Two-Sided Markets
papers.titleZh: 招募小规模一侧的力量：双边市场中只需增加两名交易者即可
papers.abstract: We study Bulow-Klemperer-style competition complexity in two-sided double auctions with $m$ unit-demand buyers drawn i.i.d. from $F_B$ and $n$ unit-supply sellers drawn i.i.d. from $F_S$. When $m \ge n$ and buyer valuations first-order stochastically dominate seller costs ($F_B \succeq_{\mathrm{FSD}} F_S$), we prove that recruiting just two additional sellers enables Seller Trade Reduction (STR), a prior-independent mechanism, to achieve expected Gains From Trade (GFT) at least the first-best GFT of the original market. When the buyer side is the smaller side of the market ($m \le n$), an analogous result holds for Buyer Trade Reduction with 2 additional buyers. This resolves open questions of Babaioff, Goldner, and Gonczarowski (SODA 2020) and Cai, Liaw, Mehta, and Zhao (STOC 2024). We complement our upper bound by showing that this uniform bound is optimal: already for $m = n = 1$, no prior-free mechanism (deterministic or randomized) that is dominant-strategy incentive-compatible, individually rational, and weakly budget-balanced can match the first-best GFT by recruiting only one additional seller.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在双边市场中增加少量参与者就能弥补效率损失？传统机制设计面临买卖双方激励相容、个体理性与预算平衡难以同时满足的问题，Myerson-Satterthwaite定理表明即使双边贸易也无法实现完全效率。本文承接Bulow-Klemperer式竞争复杂性研究，追问：当买方估值主导卖方成本时，最少需招募多少额外交易者才能使简单机制达到最优交易收益？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑m个买家和n个卖家的双边市场，买家独立同分布于FB，卖家独立同分布于Fs，交易规模由有效匹配决定。采用Seller Trade Reduction（STR）机制，在买方占优（m≥n）且FB一阶随机主导Fs时，仅向卖方侧增加新参与者。机制基于报价排序执行交易，并设置价格规则以保证激励相容、个体理性与弱预算平衡。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了一个紧确界：当买方规模不小于卖方且其估值分布主导卖方成本分布时，只需额外招募两名卖家，STR机制的期望交易收益即可不低于原市场的第一优交易收益OPT(m,n)；反之亦然。该结果解决了Babaioff等人与Cai等人提出的公开问题，并证明‘招募一人’不足以达成此目标，即使是随机化机制也成立。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过将期望交易收益差分解为按秩次的阈值积分，将原问题转化为逐层比较概率事件的非负性问题。核心技巧是在量化空间中分析‘招募增益’与‘交易缩减损失’之间的权衡，利用顺序统计量密度函数和截断积分方法，结合凸性与单调性论证积分非负，从而避开以往依赖大量参与者或双侧招募的技术路径。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于分布间的一阶随机主导关系和单位需求/供给设定，对更一般分布或复杂偏好可能不再适用。尽管如此，本文提供了极简招募策略的精确边界，揭示了市场设计中‘在哪一侧增加流动性’比‘增加多少’更为关键。最值得阅读的是其紧致分析方法与对竞争复杂性的深刻洞察。

papers.title: Singleton-Attainability and Transparent Access in Matching
papers.titleZh: 单例可达性与匹配中的透明访问
papers.abstract: Matching mechanisms differ in how much of an agent's preference ranking must be determined and reported to obtain a particular object. A mechanism is singleton-attainable (SA) if every object that an agent can obtain through some report can also be obtained by reporting only that object as acceptable. With an SA mechanism, once an attainable object has been identified, the agent need not rank or report any other object. Singleton-attainability identifies a distinct dimension in matching theory and market design: transparent access to attainable outcomes, separate from incentives, stability, welfare or equity. We establish general conditions for SA and derive its strategic implications. Top-lift invariance and truncation invariance together imply SA, while strategyproofness and stability each imply SA. By contrast, no Pareto improvement over a strategyproof, individually rational, and non-wasteful mechanism is SA. In particular, every Pareto improvement over Deferred Acceptance violates SA. We introduce report width, which measures how many acceptable objects may have to be reported to obtain an object. SA mechanisms have report width one. Report width is unbounded for a large class of efficient mechanisms that Pareto-improve Deferred Acceptance. Stable selection with report-induced priorities has width one when priorities are monotone and maximal width under reverse priority dominance. Rank-welfare maximization has width one when the outside-option rank is fixed and maximal width when it is report-dependent. These results reveal a structural divide, which we call the width dichotomy: across all mechanisms and families in our classification and all structural classes we study, report width is either one or unbounded.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么有些匹配机制能让申请者仅凭申报一个学校就获得该学校的录取，而另一些则不行？本文关注匹配机制中‘透明访问’的问题：一个学生能否通过只申报她想进的学校来获得这个学校，而不必列出其他备选。这不仅影响信息负担，也关系到机制的可理解性和公平性。现有研究多聚焦于稳定性或激励相容，但透明访问是一个独立维度。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 文章采用标准的多对一匹配模型（如学生-学校匹配），其中每个学生提交一份可接受学校的有序列表，机制根据学生偏好和学校优先级决定最终分配。核心设定是允许不完全报告——学生只需列出可接受选项。研究固定其他学生报告后，某一学生获取特定学校的最小报告长度，并以此定义‘报告宽度’作为透明性的量化指标。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 作者提出了‘单例可达性’（SA）概念：若某学校可通过某种报告获得，则也能通过仅申报该校的单例报告获得。SA机制的报告宽度为1。文章发现一个重要规律——‘宽度二分法’：主流机制要么宽度为1，要么无界增长，几乎没有中间情况。此外，任何帕累托改进延迟接受（DA）的机制都不可能满足SA。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明围绕两个不变性展开：提升不变性（TLI）和截断不变性（TRI）。同时满足二者可推出SA。策略证明和稳定性各自蕴含SA。对于非SA机制，作者构造了一系列下界实例，展示为何某些机制需要越来越长的报告才能达成目标分配。这些构造揭示了尾部依赖、头部依赖等结构性原因，并用于建立宽度无界的结论。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文聚焦理论分类，未考虑实际中偏好形成的认知成本或动态调整。结果依赖于个体理性与确定性机制假设。尽管如此，其价值在于提炼出‘访问透明性’这一被忽视的设计维度。最值得读的是其清晰的概念划分、对经典机制的重新归类，以及关于报告宽度二分法的深刻洞察，这对机制设计实践具有指导意义。

papers.title: Order-Invariant Answers, Order-Sensitive Representations in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.titleZh: 答案顺序不变，表示顺序敏感：数学推理中的表现
papers.abstract: Reordering a set of mathematical rules without changing its meaning should preserve the correct answer, but must a model's internal representations stay invariant too? We investigate this question using synthetic multi-step function-composition problems, each presented under multiple rule orderings with the same correct answer. We measure accuracy and permutation signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), which quantifies how distinctly ordering patterns are represented relative to variation across problem instances. Across 16 language models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters, we find a pattern: models that solve reordered problems more accurately represent different rule orderings more distinctly. Layer-averaged permutation SNR is positively rank-correlated with accuracy in every synthetic setting we evaluate, with Spearman correlations reaching 0.86. These findings highlight a distinction between answer invariance and representation invariance: successful mathematical rule composition can accompany distinct internal representations between equivalent rule orderings. This motivates distinguishing answer invariance from representation invariance, and offers a representational perspective on mathematical reasoning beyond answer accuracy alone.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 数学推理要求从前提中推导出不变结论，即使前提顺序改变，正确答案也应一致。人们可能认为模型在准确推理时会忽略输入顺序，形成相似内部表示。但本文质疑这一假设：准确的推理是否真的伴随表示不变性？现有研究关注顺序对准确率的影响，却缺乏对模型内部表示如何响应顺序变化的分析，这限制了我们对模型推理机制的理解。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者设计了一种合成的多步函数组合任务，每个问题包含一条目标映射链和若干干扰链，通过打乱规则行的呈现顺序生成多种排列，确保答案不变。他们在三个不同难度设置下评估16个1B至8B参数的语言模型，输入为数值映射规则和查询，输出为最终数值答案。准确率衡量性能，同时引入‘置换信噪比’（permutation SNR）量化模型对不同顺序的内部表示区分度。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文揭示了一个反直觉现象：模型越准确，其内部表示对不同规则顺序的区分越明显，而非趋于一致。层平均置换SNR与准确率在多个设置下呈强正相关（最高Spearman达0.86），说明成功推理与顺序敏感的表示共存。这一发现挑战了‘正确推理应忽略无关顺序’的直觉，提供了超越准确率的表示层面洞察，表明高表现模型可能利用顺序线索辅助推理。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是构造受控的规则重排任务，并定义置换SNR来度量隐藏表示中顺序模式的可分性。该指标比较相同排列模式下跨问题表示的聚类中心间距与类内方差，值越高表示顺序信号越清晰。通过在统一prompt下提取各层均池化表示并计算SNR，作者建立了表示几何与推理性能之间的关联，实验证据支持了表示敏感性与高准确率的正向关系。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论基于合成任务和特定模型族，未证明顺序编码因果提升推理能力，且模型间存在共享血统和训练数据，可能影响普适性。调整模型大小后相关性减弱，提示规模可能混淆变量。尽管如此，论文的价值在于提出了‘答案不变性’与‘表示不变性’的分离视角，最值得读的是其问题设定与表示分析方法，为理解模型推理提供了新工具。

papers.title: Finite-Sample Probabilistic Safety Certification for AI-Based Grid-Edge Coordination
papers.titleZh: 基于有限样本的概率性安全认证用于AI驱动的电网边缘协调
papers.abstract: Coordinating large population of flexible grid-edge devices can alleviate the need for time-consuming and capital-intensive network upgrades, and AI-based control methods such as multi-agent reinforcement learning or imitation learning are promising in their real-time decision scalability. However, system operators still need an independent and rigorous way to decide whether a given AI system is safe enough for deployment. This paper develops a finite-sample probabilistic safety certification framework for black-box AI decision models in closed-loop grid operation. The central idea is to reduce the complete input--AI--grid evaluator workflow to a binary unsafe outcome under an operator-defined safety specification, and then use exact binomial inference to certify the corresponding unsafe operation probability. Given a set of held-out calibration scenarios, the framework returns the tightest one-sided upper certificate and an accept/reject deployment criterion that controls the probability of false safety certification. Because the certification is for the calibration distribution that may deviate from the future operation, we further combine the nominal certificate with physically interpretable sample-space adversarial attacks, a concept widely used in AI to investigate the fragility of AI models. Case studies on grid-edge flexibility coordination with 1{,}000-agent AI models (independent parameters) verify the finite-sample safety guarantee and the value of integrating adversarial attacks into a rolling-window training-certification-deployment flow.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着大量灵活电网边缘设备（如电动车、热泵）接入，AI控制方法在实时协调上展现出潜力，但其黑箱特性使系统运营商难以确信其部署安全性。现有形式化验证方法因计算复杂度高难以扩展至大规模系统，而传统基于留出集的评估缺乏严格的统计保障。本文旨在建立一种适用于闭环运行中黑箱AI模型的安全认证机制，解决如何在有限样本下提供可信赖的安全概率保证的问题。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定在一个包含1000个独立AI代理的IEEE 123节点配电网中，每个代理控制一个设备并基于本地观测做出决策。输入包括时间、电价、负荷、电压等特征，输出为控制动作。通过仿真器执行闭环控制，并以节点电压越限作为二元安全判定结果。认证基于一组独立同分布的校准场景，评估AI系统在不同安全阈值下的不安全操作概率。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了一个有限样本下的概率性安全认证框架，利用精确的二项分布推断（Clopper-Pearson区间）给出最紧的一侧上界证书，确保在指定置信水平下对不安全概率的保守估计。结合对抗攻击增强鲁棒性，在滚动窗口实验中验证了该方法能有效覆盖未来实际运行中的风险，显著优于仅依赖经验频率的传统评估方式。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是将复杂的AI-电网闭环行为简化为二元安全结果序列，从而将安全认证转化为对伯努利变量的成功概率进行有限样本统计推断。在此基础上引入样本空间层面的对抗扰动——在需求、发电等输入场景上施加物理可解释的扰动预算，寻找最恶劣情况下的安全表现，进而生成更具鲁棒性的认证边界，增强了对分布偏移和模拟器误差的抵御能力。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 该方法依赖于校准数据与未来运行分布一致的假设，在存在强时间相关性或剧烈分布漂移时需借助对抗攻击缓解。此外，证书质量受限于校准样本量，极低风险认证需要大量数据。尽管如此，其轻量级计算和清晰的概率解释使其极具实用价值。最值得阅读的是其将统计验证与对抗鲁棒性融合的系统设计思路及其在真实电力场景中的实证流程。

papers.title: LAYERSCOPE: A Layerwise Characterization of Video and Multimodal Learned Representations
papers.titleZh: LAYERSCOPE: 视频与多模态学习表示的逐层刻画
papers.abstract: We propose LAYERSCOPE, a label-free, layerwise framework that aims to characterize a model's learned representations in video and multimodal settings. Evaluating downstream performance using representations from final or intermediate layers typically requires large amounts of labeled data, repeated task-specific evaluations, and substantial computation. To address these limitations, LAYERSCOPE uses local, global, distributional, and correspondence-based geometric metrics to compare layerwise representation structure within and across models without requiring task-specific labels. We evaluate seven architecturally diverse models across video and multimodal classification, clustering, and text-to-video retrieval tasks from MVEB/MVEB+. We find that intermediate-layer representations can outperform final-layer and model-default outputs. We also find that no single geometric metric consistently predicts downstream performance, but note that distinct layerwise geometric signatures emerge across model families. LID shows task-dependent relationships with performance, while RankMe provides the strongest measure for classification and clustering, but is not a universal layer selector. We also find that pairing-aware metrics explain retrieval better than distributional distances alone. LAYERSCOPE therefore offers a framework for comparing representations across models and layers, enabling a more systematic evaluation in video and multimodal settings.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有视频与多模态模型通常仅依赖最终输出进行评测，忽略了中间层表示的潜力。由于标注成本高且任务特定，全面评估各层性能不现实。本文旨在解决如何在无标签情况下，系统刻画不同网络深度下表示结构的变化，并判断哪些几何特性能够反映下游任务表现。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在七种异构视频与多模态模型上展开，涵盖分类、聚类和文本-视频检索任务。通过冻结模型提取每一层的隐藏状态，分别计算局部、全局及跨模态的几何度量，并与对应的下游任务性能对比，评估这些度量能否预测最优表示所在层次。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出LAYERSCOPE框架，发现中间层常优于最终层输出，且不同模型族呈现独特的‘几何签名’。结果显示单一几何指标无法普适预测最佳层，但RankMe对分类与聚类较有效，而配对感知度量更能解释检索性能，揭示了表示演化与任务间的复杂关系。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法结合多种几何度量：用LID衡量局部流形复杂性，RankMe捕捉全局谱利用， sliced 2-Wasserstein距离评估边际分布接近性，Procrustes误差检测跨模态配对结构。通过层间关联分析与选择遗憾（regret）量化其与下游性能的一致性，从而系统比较不同表示的质量。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论受限于所选模型与任务范围，且几何度量仅提供代理信号而非替代任务评测。尽管RankMe表现较好，但并非通用层选择器。最值得阅读的是其系统性分析框架与对几何签名的实证观察，为模型诊断与表示理解提供了可复用的方法论视角。

papers.title: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
papers.abstract: Physical intelligence requires more than predicting how the world may evolve: predictions must remain actionable as the world continues to change. We introduce InternW0, the first instantiation of the InternW physical world model series from Shanghai AI Laboratory, built around omnimodal interfaces, asynchronous multi-frequency processing, and local physical modeling under partial observations and external influences. InternW0 jointly learns future visual dynamics and continuous robot control through an asymmetric video--action architecture with flow matching. A high-capacity video expert provides longer-horizon predictive context, while a lightweight action expert operates at a faster timescale. Instead of regenerating the future for every action update, InternW0 reuses layerwise K/V and adapts it to newly observed states through observation-conditioned context routing. Domain-specific interfaces and soft prompts support heterogeneous embodiments, while contact-aware post-training incorporates force and tactile signals for contact-rich manipulation. We train InternW0 on approximately 7,200 hours of heterogeneous robot and egocentric data, including EgoLab, a 275-hour real-laboratory egocentric dataset. Evaluation spans simulation benchmarks and real-world scientific tasks, including a 15-stage metal--organic framework synthesis workflow and 5-stage contact- and force-aware dexterous manipulation for general-purpose quantitative pipetting. These results advance scalable, asynchronous, and science-native physical world models for universal and efficient real-world interactions.

papers.title: Can LLMs Catch a Rigged Backtest? A Clean-Control Calibration Benchmark
papers.titleZh: 大语言模型能发现操纵的回测吗？一个清洁对照校准基准
papers.abstract: Backtest auditing is a calibration problem: high flaw recall is not useful when the model falsely flags matched clean strategies. We build a 96-item paired benchmark in which every flawed backtest has a clean control that holds strategy, dates, code style, labels, and reporting scaffold fixed while changing one methodology detail. A deterministic scorer separates flaw recall, clean-control false positives, evidence localization, and fix relevance. Over 1440 cached audits from four text endpoints, the primary DeepSeek auditor reaches 100.0\% closed and clean-aware code recall, but open prompts over-flag 93.8\% of clean code controls, and clean-aware all-three specificity is 87.5\% even where recall saturates. A clean-aware warning drops DeepSeek code false positives from 20.8\% (95\% CI 11.7--34.3) to 0.0\% (0.0--7.4) at unchanged recall, while the budget anchor still flags 38/48 clean controls under the same prompt. Reporting recall alone would rank three of these four models identically; reporting the clean-control rate separates them by 79 points.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 回测审计不仅是发现错误，更要避免误伤干净策略。现有方法常因高召回率掩盖了大量对正常代码的误报，导致审查资源浪费。本文指出，真正的审计能力在于校准：既要抓出漏洞，也要放过正确实现。传统仅报告召回率的做法无法区分这一点，因此需要新的评估框架来揭示模型在真实场景下的可用性。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了一个包含96项配对样本的基准，每项都有一个带缺陷版本和一个与其完全匹配的清洁对照版本，二者仅在方法细节上不同。通过向大语言模型提交文本或代码形式的回测描述，并使用确定性评分器分别评估其对缺陷识别、证据定位、修复建议和清洁样本误判的情况，系统测试了不同提示设置下模型的表现。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了‘清洁感知’提示设计，在保持100%缺陷召回的同时，将对清洁代码的误报率从20.8%降至0%，显著提升了审计实用性。结果显示，仅看召回率会误导模型排序——四个模型在此指标上相同，但在清洁控制误报上相差达79个百分点，凸显了新评测维度的关键价值。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是控制变量式的配对设计：每个缺陷案例都有一个保留相同策略、时间、风格但修正方法漏洞的清洁对照。通过开放、封闭和清洁感知三类提示对比，分离出模型是真正理解漏洞还是依赖可疑模式匹配。评分机制独立衡量召回、误报、证据准确性和修复相关性，形成完整证据链。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 样本规模较小，每类缺陷仅6例，且数据为合成而非真实回测笔记。所有调用均为单次零温度生成，未模拟多轮交互。尽管如此，论文的价值在于其严谨的问题抽象和评测设计，最值得阅读的是其配对基准构建逻辑与对‘校准优于单纯召回’的深刻论证，这对AI在专业领域的可信部署具有普遍启示。
